title: Stable black hole solutions with cosmological hair
summary: Dynamical dark energy theories generically introduce a time-dependent field that causes the accelerated expansion of the Universe on large scales. When embedding black hole solutions in such a cosmological spacetime, this time dependence naturally gives rise to cosmological hair, i.e. the local black hole physics is no longer controlled by just the mass and spin of the black hole, but also impacted by the dark energy field.
